description:
Local-first AI token usage & cost tracker for 29 AI coding tools — with native apps. Never reads prompts.

TokenTracker is an accurate, local-first token usage and cost dashboard for 29 AI coding tools including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and Qoder. It automatically collects token usage and aggregates everything locally, with a desktop pet, 4 native widgets, and 15 achievement tracks. No cloud account, no API keys, no setup. The Windows app runs as a system-tray companion that never reads your prompts.
What's Changed
- fix(pricing): add Kimi K3.1 Pro / Highspeed official USD rates by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/875
- fix(trae-cn): discover classic "Trae CN" data directory by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/881
- feat: OpenSquilla usage tracking (review hardening) by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/883
- fix(windows): dedicated OAuth login window (no tab sweep) by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/882
- chore(release): v1.4.12 by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/884
Full Changelog: https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/compare/v1.4.11...v1.4.12
